title: Uttar Pradesh state subsidies
definition: Annual revenue expenditure classified as subsidies by the Government of Uttar Pradesh, as compiled in Reserve Bank of India State Finances Statement 36.

sources.title: State Finances: A Study of Budgets of 2025-26 — Statement 36: Subsidies
